MODIFY src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-plan/PROMPT.md. Use current hexagonal boundaries and preserve the parser contract. FR-001.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Host architecture and toolchain in planning prompts — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-plan/PROMPT.md:15-15,214-240
  EXPECTED: Generic prompts direct the planner to the host repository's architecture documents and use the host toolchain in executable gate examples.
  ACTUAL: The conditioned Python prompt says 'Reference existing project structure from `docs/grounding/architecture.md`' and gives `pnpm run build` and `pnpm vitest run` as canonical commands. The phase test reproduces both leaks.
  FIX: Scope GWRK paths and commands to the GWRK profile. Use host documentation and project-native commands in the generic branch. Keep the fenced bash grammar and exit-code assertions.

MODIFY src/plugins/builtins/personas/principal-engineer.md. Use the project's verification commands and schema standards. FR-001.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Principal Engineer reporting requirements — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/personas/principal-engineer.md:29-31
  EXPECTED: Preserve the `**From: Principal Engineer**` attribution on PR comments and the `@[PROJECT_LEAD]` escalation for ambiguity in rules, guardrails or architecture.
  ACTUAL: The replacement Output section delegates to the workflow's report contract and omits both reporting directives. The phase test checks both omissions.
  FIX: Restore the attribution and escalation instructions alongside the project-selected verification and schema standards.

MODIFY src/utils/agent.ts. Add shared conflict guidance beside the intact decision index. FR-002.. Tests: src/utils/agent.grounding-decisions.test.ts
Source implementation and all four native task gates are preserved. The phase gate now captures real WorkflowRuntime prompt delivery through dry-run shared dispatch for specification, planning and review. All 49 checks pass. Clear implementation through independent review.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Record architecture conflicts in the plan — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/utils/agent.ts:615-619
  EXPECTED: The shared authority block instructs agents to follow Decided constraints and record any conflict with a Proposed target in the plan.
  ACTUAL: It says 'stop and resolve the conflict before implementation'. Captured specification, planning and CLI review prompts preserve the decision index but omit the plan-recording step.
  FIX: Add an explicit instruction to record the conflict in the plan. Keep the full index verbatim and the shared authority block outside it.
